column1: # The Photographer and the Silent Man at their worst: id, seconds, destination, prompt.

column4: A man whispers very close into a microphone, wet and breathless, a single word that sounds like 'smile', with a soft giggle after, intimate and wrong, no music.
A middle-aged man laughing with a throat full of liquid, a gurgling choking giggle that keeps going too long, close, no music.
Wet skin slowly peeling away from flesh, a sticky tearing and dripping sound, close, disgusting, no music.
An instant photo developing in a quiet room: a faint chemical fizz and a slow low hum rising, then a sharp tick, no music.
Heavy hiking boots sprinting fast on gravel straight towards the listener, a camera rattling on its strap, panting laughter, ending right at the microphone, no music.
A neck cracking and grinding slowly as a head turns too far, wet gristle popping, close, no music.
A deep wet throat opening, a slow clicking of many small teeth inside it, a hollow gurgling exhale, close, no music.
Skin and sinew stretching and creaking like wet leather pulled too far, slow, with small pops, close, no music.
Something scuttling quickly across a wooden ceiling above, fingernails tapping, then stopping directly overhead, a drip falling, no music.
A muffled scream heard from inside someone's closed mouth, as if a second person were trapped inside his head, no music.
